reason: Provides a chat-page status bar for monitoring background task counts, details, and live output tails through read-only task and output routes.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框上方显示后台任务数量、状态详情和实时输出尾部，帮助用户监控正在运行的任务。
summaries.en: Adds a chat-page status bar that shows background task counts, expandable details, and live output tails for monitoring running tasks.

capabilities: Displays background task counts and per-task status in the chat interface
Polls and displays task output tails
Provides read-only task list and output routes
Applies a mirror patch to task output reads
